android.desc:
FL Studio Mobile allows you to produce, write, make beats, and mix whenever, wherever, on your phone, tablet, or Chromebook, with Lifetime Free Updates.

Start your beat with built-in sounds
- Dive into thousands of sounds inside FL Studio Mobile, and build the foundations of your beat.

Compose your melody
- Tap notes directly into the Piano Roll, with full control over note pitch, length, and velocity.

Shape your sound
- Bring your music to life with creative effects like Tape Stop, Wow and Flutter, Waveshaper, and Stereo Spreader.

Finish your track
- The advanced mixer controls let you tweak and add the finishing touches to your track.

*KEY FEATURES*
- 8 instruments including: MiniSynth, DW Sampler, GMSynth, Transistor Bass, SuperSaw, Slicer, 3x Osc, Drums 
- 1000+ sounds including: Basses, Bells, Keys, Plucks, Pads, Leads, and more
- 30+ effects including: Reverb, Tape Delay, Autoduck, Leveller, Compressor, Limiter, Distortion, Gate, Multiband Compressor, Filter, Param and Graphic EQ, Stereorizer, Spacer, Chorus, Flanger, Phaser, Tuner, Waveshaper, Tape Stop, Wow & Flutter, Tremolo, and more.
- Mixer tools including: per-track mute, solo, send level, pan, and volume adjustment
- Capture vocals or real-life instruments and arrange them in your track with audio recording. Record vocals and stay perfectly in tune or transform your voice in real time using Pitcher 2.
- Stretch and repitch audio with precision – adjust tempo and pitch independently while keeping everything perfectly in sync.
- Great chords without the guesswork. The Chords Keyboard helps you build harmonies and progressions instantly.
- Browse and add new sound packs and presets to expand your library with fresh sounds.
- Export mobile projects as .flp files to continue working in FL Studio Desktop. Or export to WAV, MP3, AAC, FLAC, or MIDI for use in any DAW.
- Add expression to your productions by recording automation for volume, panning, filters, and more. Or draw your automation in for even more precise control.
- Transfer projects between devices on the same network to keep producing anywhere.
- Connect your class compliant MIDI controller wirelessly or wired and stay in the flow wherever you are.
- Pick from a range of built-in themes and shape the interface to suit your style and the way you like to create.
- Analyze your audio in real time with Spectrum Analyzer, Oscilloscope, LUFS, and TruePeak for accurate, reliable mix control.
